criterion_text: On isolated real Agent/tmux Sessions A and B, create from a contaminated launch environment, reapply/replace/clear Profiles, create panes, restart/reconnect Agent and repair pre-existing bad adapter/owned runtime env: new shells converge to their own correct baseline; other Session profiles/revisions, tmux global env, identity and live panes are preserved. Repeating recovery is idempotent; unrepairable state is explicit and no existing process is falsely reported updated. Include Bash and legacy/runtime key non-regression.

verifiers.summary: Repair converges each Session to its own zsh baseline without disturbing others

evidence.value: staging 64aede9ec15eb96de1511d68c27c44cd7d16b598: real tmux Sessions A and B on a private socket — the contaminated launch environment produced B's own validated adapter; a legacy contaminated adapter was repaired on reapply and after an Agent restart while A's profiles/revision, binding record, identities, tmux global environment, live panes and a legitimate legacy marker stayed unchanged; a repeated recovery was silent, a stale legacy marker was removed while NESSION_MCP_TOKEN survived, a damaged durable record stayed explicit with no tmux mutation, and the surviving legacy Bash adapter plus a real Bash prompt remained unchanged
